payload.description: For elections before 2023 the council's results archive no longer carries a page, so the dates come from the committee system's own election history and no vote count or majority is shown. In wards electing more than one councillor at the same time — Wensum in 2026 — each winner's majority is worked out against the same best-placed losing candidate, so two winners in one ward can show different majorities.

ai.reviewed_by: two independent AI review passes, reconciled against the source documents, 8 September 2026
